thread:
Maya: Quick sync — pricing simulator for the launch. Need copy, routing rules for high-intent vs self-serve, FAQ snippets, and the webinar CTA flow. Goal: keep calculator lightweight but capture leads that look enterprise-ready. Thoughts? :wave:
Ethan: +1. Propose simple rule: if estimated monthly > $5k OR user checks 'I need SLA/Contract', tag as sales lead. Otherwise nurture via automated drip and webinar invite.
Lina: Love that. Two quick CTA variants: (A) 'Get a tailored quote' (sales) and (B) 'Run my estimate — instant' (self-serve). Mock in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/pricing-sim-variants (see frames: CTA-A, CTA-B) :eyes:
Omar: Data sanity check — our page baseline conversion to trial is ~3.7%. Micro-simulators historically add +1.5–2% if performance is smooth. If we add a soft lead capture for >$5k we should expect 20–25 leads/mo at current traffic. Also putting sample tracking snippet: ```js
// push calc result to dataLayer for GTM
window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || []
window.dataLayer.push({
  event: 'pricing_calc',
  calc_commit_level: commitLevel, // 'low' | 'medium' | 'high'
  est_monthly_usd: Math.round(monthlyCost)
})
```
Priya: Copy idea for the micro-FAQ on the calculator panel (short bullets):
- "How is cost estimated?" — We estimate based on tokens/requests per minute; fine-tune later with your telemetry.
- "Can I reserve capacity?" — Yes — select Dedicated to get committed capacity and SLA.
- "Need a contract?" — Choose 'Get a tailored quote' and our sales team will reach out.
Keep language scannable, one-liners.
Jules: From AE POV — please include a hidden query param when they hit 'Get a tailored quote' so we can linkback to the calc values (eg. ?lead_from=sim&est=1234&commit=high). That way we see the ask in Salesforce. Also add a checkbox: 'We're evaluating >$5k/mo' to reduce form friction. :+1:
Lina: UX note — checkbox should be shown only if est_monthly > $1k to avoid clutter. Also add a tiny tooltip: "Why we ask this" text linking to SLA details.
Omar: For analytics routing: funnel event chain = page_view -> open_calculator -> submit_calc -> click_quote_cta. We can add a segment for 'calc_high_intent' where est_monthly >= 5000 || checked_contract_box == true. Export these to our BI with tag calc_segment.
Maya: Great. Priya — can you propose 3 short tier names for the page and for the calculator dropdown? Avoid generic. Need something developer-friendly but signal scale.
Priya: Draft names: ["Starter", "Scale", "Anchor"]. Alternate option (more product-led): ["Launch", "Momentum", "Command"]. My vote: Launch/Momentum/Command — feels progressive and action-oriented.
Jules: I like Launch/Momentum/Command. For sales messaging, 'Command' reads enterprise-grade.
LegalBot: Quick reminder — any mention of contractual uptime or financial commitments should have a link to standard terms. Copy must include "Subject to terms" where we reference Dedicated commitments. I can provide the snippet.
SupportBot: FAQ suggestions from support: add two short Qs: 
- "Can I change my plan mid-cycle?" — Yes, prorated adjustments apply.
- "How do we measure usage?" — We provide token-level usage in Console and monthly invoice.
Maya: Perfect. Action items and owners:
- Lina: finalize CTA designs + tooltip (due Fri)
- Priya: pick final tier names + 2-line descriptions for each (due Thu)
- Omar: add GTM/event contract + set calc_segment in BI (due Thu)
- Jules: UX for quote form params + optional checkbox wording (due Thu)
- LegalBot: paste terms snippet and minimal compliance line (due Thu)
- SupportBot: short FAQ microcopy to drop in panel (due Thu)
Ethan: Webinar tie-in: let's auto-enroll self-serve users who complete a calc with est_monthly between $500–5k into the next onboarding webinar. High-intent (>5k) get immediate sales outreach + option to schedule a bespoke webinar. Means our webinar landing should accept a prefilled est param.
Lina: Will add prefill states. Also proposing a subtle microcopy under the calc: "Prefer a walkthrough? Join our 30-min product webinar" with a toggle to 'Enroll me'.
Maya: Deadline for copy/design freeze = next Tue EOD. If we miss, we shift launch 1 week. Everyone OK? :speaker:
Priya: OK from product side.
Jules: OK from sales.
Omar: OK — I'll start the tracking ticket now.
Lina: OK — will upload final frames to Figma and tag.
LegalBot: I'll drop the terms snippet in this thread when ready.
SupportBot: I'll add the FAQ entries to the help center draft and share link.
Maya: Thanks all — I'll compile a single checklist and post here tomorrow. :thumbsup:
